about.title: About Leaf AI
about.subtitle: AI-Powered Plant Disease Detection System for Farmers
about.model_info: Built with MobileNetV2 Deep Learning Model
about.intro_text: is an advanced AI-powered plant disease detection system designed to help farmers and gardeners identify leaf diseases quickly and accurately. Using state-of-the-art deep learning technology, our system can analyze images of plant leaves and provide instant diagnosis with treatment recommendations.
about.intro_model_text: a powerful convolutional neural network architecture optimized for mobile and edge devices. This makes our detection system fast, accurate, and accessible to farmers worldwide, even those using smartphones with limited connectivity.
about.ai_model_subtitle: Deep learning architecture and technical specifications
about.system_arch_subtitle: How the detection system works end-to-end
about.origin_desc: Native to tropical forests of India, Africa, and Australia. Thrives in warm, humid climates.
about.botanical_desc: Woody climbing plant with opposite, oval leaves. Small yellow flowers in umbel-like clusters.
about.common_names_desc: Gurmar (Hindi), Meshashringi (Sanskrit), Australian Cowplant, Periploca of the Woods.
about.health_benefits_subtitle: Scientifically studied therapeutic properties of Gymnema sylvestre
about.benefit_blood_sugar_desc: Helps reduce sugar absorption in the intestines and may lower blood glucose levels naturally.
about.benefit_weight_desc: Suppresses sugar cravings and may help reduce body weight when combined with a healthy lifestyle.
about.benefit_anti_diabetic_desc: Stimulates insulin secretion from pancreatic beta cells and may regenerate islet cells.
about.benefit_sweet_taste_desc: Gymnemic acids temporarily suppress the taste of sweetness, helping reduce sugar intake.
about.benefit_cholesterol_desc: May help lower LDL cholesterol and triglyceride levels while supporting heart health.
about.benefit_anti_inflammatory_desc: Contains compounds with anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties for overall wellness.
about.scientific_subtitle: Active compounds and mechanisms of action
about.active_compounds_desc: Gymnemic acids (gymnemagenin, gymnemasaponins), gurmarin protein, and triterpene saponins.
about.mechanism_desc: Blocks sweet taste receptors, inhibits glucose absorption in intestines, and stimulates insulin production.
about.traditional_use_desc: Used in Ayurvedic medicine for over 2,000 years as 'Gurmar' (sugar destroyer) for diabetes treatment.
about.dataset_subtitle: How we built our training dataset
about.dataset_text: Our model was trained on a comprehensive dataset of leaf images collected from various sources, including field photographs and agricultural research databases.

dosage.title: Agronomic Support
dosage.subtitle: Comprehensive guide to cultivating, protecting, and utilizing Gymnema sylvestre
dosage.group_adults_desc: General wellness and maintenance dosage recommendations
dosage.group_sugar_desc: Specialized dosage for diabetes and blood sugar management
dosage.group_weight_desc: Dosage recommendations for weight loss and sugar cravings
dosage.prec_consult_desc: Always consult with a qualified healthcare professional before starting Gymnema sylvestre, especially if you have diabetes, hypoglycemia, or take medications that affect blood sugar levels.
dosage.prec_meds_desc: Gymnema may interact with diabetes medications, insulin, blood sugar-lowering drugs, and cholesterol medications. Medical supervision is essential to prevent hypoglycemia.
dosage.prec_pregnancy_desc: Not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding due to insufficient safety data. Avoid use unless specifically directed by a healthcare provider.
dosage.prec_monitor_desc: If diabetic or pre-diabetic, monitor blood glucose levels frequently when starting Gymnema. Watch for signs of hypoglycemia: dizziness, shakiness, confusion, or weakness.
dosage.prec_surgery_desc: Stop taking Gymnema at least 2 weeks before scheduled surgery, as it may affect blood sugar control during and after the procedure.
dosage.prec_quality_desc: Purchase from reputable suppliers. Look for standardized extracts (25% gymnemic acids) and third-party testing certificates for purity and potency.
dosage.tip_time_desc: Take 15-30 minutes before meals for maximum effectiveness in blood sugar management and reducing sugar cravings.
dosage.tip_food_desc: Can be taken on an empty stomach, but if you experience digestive discomfort, take with a small amount of food.
dosage.tip_consistency_desc: Take at the same times each day for best results. It may take 4-6 weeks to notice full effects.
dosage.tip_hydrate_desc: Drink plenty of water throughout the day when taking Gymnema to support optimal absorption and metabolism.
dosage.tip_start_desc: Begin with the lowest recommended dose and gradually increase over 1-2 weeks to assess tolerance and effectiveness.
dosage.tip_duration_desc: Can be used long-term under medical supervision. Most studies show benefits within 18-24 months of consistent use.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about leaf disease detection
faq.search_desc: Can't find what you're looking for? Search our knowledge base
faq.q1: How do I identify powdery mildew?
faq.a1: White powdery patches appear on leaves and stems. Look for a flour-like coating on the upper surface of leaves.
faq.a2: High humidity, crowding, and poor airflow encourage powdery mildew. It thrives in warm, dry conditions with high humidity.
faq.a3: Fungal or bacterial infection favored by wet conditions. Typically appears as brown or black spots with yellow halos.
faq.a4: Small green, black, or yellow insects on leaves and stems. They cluster on new growth and undersides of leaves.
faq.a5: Helps manage diabetes, weight, and cholesterol. Known as 'sugar destroyer' in traditional medicine.
faq.a6: 200–400 mg extract or 2–3 grams dried leaf daily. Always consult a healthcare professional first.
faq.q7: How accurate is the AI detection?
faq.a7: Our AI model achieves 99.2% accuracy, trained on over 10,000 leaf images with continuous improvements.
faq.a8: Yes! We use secure encryption and never store your images permanently. All processing is done in real-time.
